items.title: Chuck Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 7, 2023
items.q: my brother, the next oldest brother, John, was a guitar player and he was playing with us also so there was three brothers

ctx.x: No he played guitar, he played guitar kind of throughout that thing and then when we made the switch, there’s a lot of ancillary roots in these stories of course, but my brother, the next oldest brother, John, was a guitar player and he was playing with us also so there was three brothers. He went to Columbia University and met a drummer, a really great jazz drummer who came back to Verona and then it was like well how about he plays drums and you play piano? It was sort of the start of my — and I said okay. That…
Did you have a clear idea, a goal, a concept of what it meant to make it in the music business?
